results.use_case: set up and organize new email subscriber lists
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if avoiding duplicates)] [Prerequisite]: List existing groups using MAILERLITE_GET_GROUPS (check for exact-name matches before creating).
[Required] [Step]: Create subscriber group using MAILERLITE_CREATE_GROUP (create the group and capture the returned group identifier).
[Optional (if verifying creation/details)] [Step]: Fetch the created group using MAILERLITE_GET_GROUP (confirm final name/details match expectations).
[Optional (if details change)] [Next Step]: Update the group using MAILERLITE_UPDATE_GROUP (rename/adjust details using the captured identifier).
[Optional (if populating the group)] [Next Step]: Add members using MAILERLITE_ADD_SUBSCRIBER_TO_GROUP (repeat per subscriber with the group identifier).
[Optional (if auditing membership)] [Step]: Retrieve group members using MAILERLITE_GET_GROUP_SUBSCRIBERS (review current membership).
[Optional (if cleaning up test/obsolete groups)] [Step]: Delete the group using MAILERLITE_DELETE_GROUP (only after explicit confirmation).
[Optional (if avoiding duplicates)] [Prerequisite]: Check existing audiences using MAILCHIMP_LIST_AUDIENCES (quick scan before creating a similarly named audience).
[Required] [Step]: After explicit user confirmation, create the new audience using MAILCHIMP_ADD_LIST (include required contact and campaign-default fields; store returned list_id).
[Optional (if personalization fields are needed)] [Step]: Add merge fields using MAILCHIMP_ADD_MERGE_FIELD (repeat per field; use list_id).
[Optional (if defaults/contact info need adjustment)] [Step]: Update audience settings using MAILCHIMP_UPDATE_LISTS (apply only intended setting changes; use list_id).
[Optional (for verification/audit)] [Next Step]: Re-fetch audience configuration using MAILCHIMP_GET_LISTS_INFO (confirm settings reflect intended state).
[Optional (if MAILCHIMP_GET_LISTS_INFO response is too large/truncated)] [Fallback]: Re-check presence/name via MAILCHIMP_LIST_AUDIENCES (lighter-weight verification).
known_pitfalls: [MAILERLITE_GET_GROUPS] Results may be nested under a data field; parse the response structure before matching by name.
[MAILERLITE_GET_GROUPS] Filtering can return partial matches; validate the exact group via identifier before update/delete.
[MAILERLITE_GET_GROUPS] An empty data list typically means no groups exist; don’t treat it as an error or retry unchanged calls.
[MAILERLITE_CREATE_GROUP] The group identifier can be nested in the response payload; persist it immediately for downstream tools.
[MAILERLITE_DELETE_GROUP] Deletion is irreversible; require explicit confirmation before calling.
[MAILCHIMP_ADD_LIST] Creation can fail if required contact or campaign-default fields are missing.
[MAILCHIMP_GET_LISTS_INFO] Responses can be very large with many lists and may be truncated/stored externally; prefer lighter checks when you only need existence.
[MAILCHIMP_GET_LISTS_INFO] Connection metadata may show an auth warning while API calls still succeed; rely on a real GET_LISTS_INFO call before performing writes.
[MAILCHIMP_ADD_MERGE_FIELD] Merge fields must exist before downstream processes can reliably populate corresponding merge tags.
[MAILCHIMP_UPDATE_LISTS] Updating list settings can unintentionally overwrite existing defaults/contact info—confirm intended values before applying.

MAILERLITE_CREATE_GROUP.description: Tool to create a new subscriber group. Use after deciding the group name for categorization. Store `group_id` from the response — required by MAILERLITE_UPDATE_GROUP, MAILERLITE_DELETE_GROUP, and MAILERLITE_GET_GROUP_SUBSCRIBERS.

name.description: Name of the new subscriber group (max 255 characters).

MAILCHIMP_ADD_LIST.description: Create a new audience (list) in your Mailchimp account. This endpoint creates a new audience/list for managing email contacts. Each audience has unique settings for campaigns, permissions, and contact information. Note: Free Mailchimp accounts are limited to 1 audience. Paid plans allow multiple audiences. Required fields include: name, contact information (company, address1, city, country), permission_reminder, and campaign defaults (from_name, from_email, subject, language).

name.description: The name of the audience/list. Must be unique within your Mailchimp account.

contact__zip.description: The postal or zip code for the list contact (optional).

double_optin.description: Whether to require double opt-in (subscriber must confirm via email). Recommended for GDPR compliance. Defaults to false.

contact__city.description: The city for the list contact. Required.

contact__phone.description: The phone number for the list contact. Optional.

contact__state.description: The state or province for the list contact (optional).

use_archive_bar.description: Whether campaigns for this list use the Archive Bar in archives by default. Defaults to false.

contact__company.description: The company name for the list. Required.

contact__country.description: A two-character ISO3166 country code (e.g., 'US', 'GB', 'CA'). Required.

contact__address1.description: The street address for the list contact. Required.

contact__address2.description: The secondary street address for the list contact (optional).

email_type_option.description: Whether subscribers can choose their email format (HTML vs plain-text). When true, subscribers choose their format. When false, all receive HTML with plain-text backup.

notify_on_subscribe.description: Email address to send subscribe notifications to. Provide a valid email address or omit to disable notifications.

permission_reminder.description: The permission reminder explaining why contacts are receiving emails from this list. Example: 'You are receiving this email because you opted in via our website.'

marketing_permissions.description: Whether to enable GDPR-friendly marketing permissions. Defaults to false.

notify_on_unsubscribe.description: Email address to send unsubscribe notifications to. Provide a valid email address or omit to disable notifications.

campaign__defaults__subject.description: The default subject line for campaigns sent to this list. Required.

campaign__defaults__language.description: The default language for this list's forms (e.g., 'en' for English). Required.

campaign__defaults__from__name.description: The default 'From' name for campaigns sent to this list. Required.

campaign__defaults__from__email.description: The default 'From' email address for campaigns sent to this list. Required.

MAILERLITE_ADD_SUBSCRIBER_TO_GROUP.description: Tool to assign an existing subscriber to a group. Use when you need to add a subscriber to a specific group in your MailerLite account.

group_id.description: The unique identifier of the group to add the subscriber to.

subscriber_id.description: The unique identifier of the subscriber to add to the group.
